subject: Senior Platform Engineer — Committee Debrief / No-Offer Decision
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Senior Platform Eng — candidate update + committee request

Hi all,

Quick update on req-789 (Senior Platform Engineer, Platform Core): we completed on-site loop for Alex Rivera last week. Overall signal: strong architectural + systems design, excellent fit with product goals. Candidate is currently interviewing with another FAANG-adjacent company and has an active offer in market.

Two committee items I want to surface before we move forward:
- Compensation: Alex is asking $50k above our advertised band midpoint for the role. That's outside the published band for IC4 in US-West.
- Timing: their other offer needs a response by next Friday (7/24).

I've attached the candidate feedback pack and a refreshed JD with the role's impact map. I'd like to request a short hiring-committee quick vote today/tomorrow to determine whether we:
1) approve a band exception to match ask (requires VP approval and exec sign-off), or
2) authorize a final counter within band (and close if candidate declines), or
3) close req as 'no hire' and reallocate headcount to infra/sme hiring.

If we can't get exec approval quickly, my recommendation is option 2 — try to keep candidate engaged but not set a precedent for band escalations.

Attaching: candidate-feedback-pack-428.pdf, JD_Senior_Platform_Engineer_v3.pdf, comp-band-matrix-2026Q3.xlsx

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager, Platform Core
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Senior Platform Eng — candidate update + committee request

Jonas / team — quick recruiting note:
- Alex is high quality and proactive; recruiter reports they are leaning toward the other offer because it includes sign-on equity and a slightly higher base.
- We can extend a counter that blends base + sign-on to keep within band ceiling while improving competitiveness, but that reduces our negotiating leverage for other hires.

If committee wants to try for a band exception, we'll need finance approval (comp band exception request doc) and an exec pre-approval email to expedite. That's usually 48–72 hours. Given their deadline, that timeline is tight.

Proposed immediate action: vote now on whether recruiting should send a final counter within band with a $15k sign-on and enhanced equity refresh schedule. If "no", we recommend closing.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Senior Platform Eng — candidate update + committee request

Thanks — scheduling a short async committee vote to respect Alex's timeline. Reply-all with your vote and a one-line rationale. I'll compile and publish the outcome.

Vote options: APPROVE_BAND_EXCEPTION | FINAL_COUNTER_WITHIN_BAND | CLOSE_REQ_NO_HIRE

One line from me: FINAL_COUNTER_WITHIN_BAND — preserve hiring posture and avoid setting exception precedent unless exec pushes for this hire specifically.

Jonas Weber
VP, Engineering Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Senior Platform Eng — committee vote

Vivek Kulkarni — APPROVE_BAND_EXCEPTION
Rationale: This is a hard-to-find profile (platform infra + product sensibility); the productivity delta for Platform Core will be significant. I'm willing to approve up to $35k over band midpoint if finance signs off. If we do this, we should document as "targeted exception" tied to specific measurable deliverables (Q4 rollout ownership + mentorship metric).

Vivek
Head of Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Committee resolution: CLOSE_REQ_NO_HIRE — candidate notified / headcount reallocation

Team — thanks for the fast responses. Votes collected: APPROVE_BAND_EXCEPTION (Vivek) | FINAL_COUNTER_WITHIN_BAND (Jonas, Marissa, Laura) | (Karthik abstained). Per majority, we will NOT approve a band exception for this req. Recruiting should proceed with FINAL_COUNTER_WITHIN_BAND as outlined by Marissa: $15k sign-on + enhanced equity vesting schedule within the published band ceiling. If candidate declines, we will close the req as no-hire and reallocate the headcount to a prioritized infra role for Q3.

Marissa — please send the final counter by EOD tomorrow (7/29). If Alex accepts, coordinate with People Ops for updated offer paperwork and notify Finance for sign-off on the sign-on amount. If Alex declines, close req-789 and file a hiring-committee closeout report with reasons (market pay mismatch + competing offer).

I'll draft a short internal note summarizing the committee decision for the exec review queue.

Action items:
- Marissa: send counter (due 2026-07-29 EOD) — includes attachments: candidate offer template, approved sign-on breakdown.
- Marissa/Laura: candidate communication and feedback if declined.
- Vivek: confirm whether you want deliverable-tied exception language on file (only relevant if exec later greenlights exception).

Attachments referenced: candidate-feedback-pack-428.pdf, comp-band-matrix-2026Q3.xlsx

Jonas Weber
VP, Engineering Ops
Redwood Inference
